title: Stage-3 convention-conformance edit task
description: A goal-only small-edit/refactor task pinned to a forged/mutated corpus. The prompt states ONLY the desired behavioural/convention outcome; it never names the target path or symbol. The oracle key carries a behaviour command with a red->green discrimination, a mechanical convention rule, >=2 LIVE convention-exemplar anchors (each independently annotated), and a declared patch scope (blast radius). Anchors are expressed against MUTATED relative paths so a tool that memorised the upstream repo cannot short-circuit them.

id.description: Stable, filesystem-safe task id. Never renumbered once shipped.

category.description: The convention family this edit exercises. The bank must cover all four.

manifest_ref.description: Pins the exact forged corpus the anchors were verified against; sufficient to translate every anchor's mutated path back to its origin.

prompt.description: Under-specified, goal-ONLY instruction (make X behave like Y / bring X in line with the house style). MUST NOT name target paths, target symbols, patch locations, or the exemplar files; the validator fails a prompt that leaks any exemplar path segment or target identifier.

rubric.description: The grading key. Unlike the prompt, the rubric MAY name symbols/paths.

behavior.description: How to tell the edit worked: a command that exercises the behaviour plus a red->green discrimination assertion (what is observed before the edit vs. after).

command.description: argv that exercises the target behaviour.

discrimination.description: red != green: the pre-edit observation must differ from the post-edit one, or the assertion discriminates nothing.

red.description: What is observed BEFORE the edit (the failing state).

green.description: What is observed AFTER the edit (the passing state).

convention.description: The mechanical house-style rule the edit must satisfy. conforms_pattern is a regex every LIVE exemplar's bounded text must match; it is the machine-checkable form of the statement.

conforms_pattern.description: Regex (matched multi-line) that conforming code exhibits.

exemplars.description: Adjudicated LIVE convention-exemplar anchors: >=2 real (non-decoy) locations that already follow the convention, each against a MUTATED relative path.

blast_radius.description: The declared patch scope. allow is a non-empty set of path globs the edit may touch; a match-everything glob is rejected by the validator as degenerate.

path.description: MUTATED relative path within the forged corpus tree.

lines.description: Exact line [n] or bounded inclusive range [start, end] (start <= end).

claim.description: How this location demonstrates the convention.

target_identifiers.description: Identifiers that MUST occur within the bounded evidence; consumed by the leakage check.
